title: Verify 182 additional P104 native frame maps (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently qualifies 182 previously uncovered ordered native frame maps from PR5545 head `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`, including all 11 private returns. Combined with the retained receipts in PR5548/5550, this covers 224/2981 pairs and 254/3624 local paid occurrences. The residual is explicitly 2757 public rank1–3 pairs and 3370 paid occurrences. This is an exact finite native audit, with a conditional all-width interpretation under the retained framework. The paid profile and κ are unchanged; no full parent admission is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Base `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; publication `998d312fc3af584d39a3cf4c10a45e02a8395f48`. Scope is refined from the scalar-to-moment research task to a missing native verification layer. This complements [PR5548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5548) and [PR5550](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5550), now merged. PR5551's later four-new-map audit concerns its changed map universe and does not duplicate these 182 predecessor maps. This package does not certify automatic transfer to PR5551, PR5561 or successors. The current upstream review prioritizes those stronger constructions before assigning further old-head residual work.

## Validation

Python3.12/stdlib. Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-native-subset-independent-audit`.

The original exact normal/-O pair passed in 24.449s, sampled86.71MiB, with complete result SHA256 `fa2fe7ce93e72569f611ca810f440e6b77d92221350c51b7b6ab19ca34d6c64b`. The portable registered pair passed in26.494s, sampled115.93MiB, under the150s/512MiB guard. A separate Git-free read-only export with spaces in its path passed in8.350s, sampled89.54MiB, with empty PATH. All frozen package/export bytes remained unchanged. Metadata, source-history and exact remote-commit byte preflight passed for41 package/input files.

Checks compare the actual native recipe against all18 signed Pauli images and an independent exact dense column. Thirteen scoped controls comprise10 operator/authentication faults and3 structural sanity checks; they are not13 complete source mutations. Static wrapper corruption/symlink/extra-file tests reject before scientific launch. Hosted CI is pending at submission. Independent human/formal acceptance, the residual low-rank maps, uniform precision/tape/stock and complete compiler/outer funding were not newly established.

## Credit

Ali Romman for the P104 construction and PR5544/5545; Gareth Davidson, David Arias, Cinna Davis, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and retained native/controller/geometry/tensor/compiler contributors. Credit thu-nmrc's separate successor audit. New independent qualification/publication for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0 and source provenance retained.

## Open next questions

Rebind any reused map evidence to literal frame bytes, actual recipe and occurrences on the strongest current construction before further native work. Assess PR5561/5569 and the overlapping PR5567 endpoint audit first. A separate frozen budget and nomination are required for any remaining old-head rank band. Native coverage does not improve economics or fund κ.
